verdict.rationale: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox ships first-party plugins for Claude Code and Codex, plus Kiro, explicitly to resolve code review findings. Its MCP server lets other agents retrieve and resolve review findings, giving a direct handoff from review to coding agent. missing for 10: an explicitly documented Cursor integration, copyable per-finding fix prompts, independent or hands-on corroboration of the handoff workflow.
